page.overview:
What is Thog?

Thog the Ancient is a fictional entity created by the late American author Robert E. Howard for his 1933 short story "The Slithering Shadow".

An octopus-like monstrosity of the Hyborian Age, Thog is a man eating abomination which haunts the underground city of Xuthal.

Thog the Ancient is a Great Old One, residing within the subterranean city of Xuthal. It preyed on the city's Black Lotus addicted dreaming inhabitants whom were slowly being consumed by the hungry entity which roamed its dark corridors. They were also prey to its cosmic lusts, as Conan's companion Natala discovered to her horror. Xuthal's inhabitants whom lived for sensual pleasures, lived in terror of it, and would draw lots to see whom would be thrown to Thog to satisfy its lust and hunger.

In the Marvel Multiverse, Thog the Ancient was seemingly the same (including his encounter with Conan, though it is unknown if he was one of the Great Old Ones, or a Lesser Old One.
